distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) noted records from Japan, Mongolia, the Russian Far East and possibly Korea but could trace no Taiwan record; the historical Taiwan attribution is retained as doubtful only.

host_note: No host evidence is reported for this doubtful Taiwan record.
